مُخْطَفُ الحَشَا , applied to a horse, (assumed tropical:) Lean, or lank, in the part of the belly that is behind the place of the girth: (S:) and مُخْطَفٌ [alone] is applied to a man [in a similar sense]; as also
↓ مَخْطُوفٌ : (TA:) and مُخْطَفُ البَطْنِ (assumed tropical:) lean, or lank, in the belly; syn. مُنْطَوِيهِ; (Lth, K;) applied to a camel, and to an ass: (Lth, TA:) and الحَشَا ↓ أَخْطَفُ and ↓ مَخْطُوفُهُ , applied to a man, [signify the same,] (tropical:) i. q. ضَامِرُهُ. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
